description: Convert pay between per hour, day, week, every 2 weeks, twice a month, month and year using your hours per week, days per week and weeks per year (defaults 40 / 5 / 52). Optional overtime (hours per week × multiplier, e.g. 1.25, 1.5, 2) and a raise given as a percent or as the new monthly pay. Amounts are rounded to 2 decimals. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/salary-calc/

currency.description: Optional ISO currency code for the text summary (e.g. USD, JOD).

newMonthlyPay.description: Or: the new monthly pay (gives the raise percent).

raisePercent.description: Optional raise in percent (gives the new pay).

name: calc_salary
title: Salary / pay period converter
